text:
anna: Quick mini-workshop notes  proposing a compact left rail that groups Models / Deployments / Runtimes under one parent called 'Inference'. Goal: declutter and keep deep links stable. Mock: https://img.redwood/mock/mini-inference.png.

mike: 👍 fewer top-level items looks cleaner. Main concerns: permalinks/bookmarks and breadcrumb clarity for non-ML folks.

olivia: a11y first: when a deep link lands we must expand the parent, set aria-expanded=true, and move focus to main content. Breadcrumb must be semantic nav>ol>li with aria-current on the active item. If the visual breadcrumb truncates on small screens, provide an accessible full-path label that SRs can read.

kevin: Routing: prefer canonical routes like /inference/models/:id. Implement server-side redirects from old slugs (/models/:id -> /inference/models/:id) and preserve query params. Avoid hash-only toggles.

sam: Implementation plan: on route resolve, run redirect resolution first, expand nav parents synchronously, then mount page and call focus() on H1. For UI-only toggles use history.replaceState to avoid back-button noise. Also emit telemetry when a redirect fires.

dan: Add UX for redirects: show a dismissible banner when users land via redirect saying "You were redirected from /models/123 to /inference/models/123" to help surface stale links. Keep redirect mapping live for at least 90 days.

olivia: QA checklist request: 1) deep link into nested page with collapsed rail, 2) focus lands in main content, 3) aria-expanded announced, 4) breadcrumb SR full readout when truncated, 5) preserved query params after redirect, 6) reduced-motion respected.

anna: Copy question  'Inference' vs 'Serve' vs 'Runtime'? Leaning to Inference to match docs. Will run a quick hallway test.

mike: +1 Inference + tooltip: "Models, deployments, and runtimes for serving models."

preview-bot: Prototype up: https://deploy.redwood/pr/1801. Includes keyboard walkthrough and a11y notes.

kevin: Noted preview bug: prototype expands sections with a hash fragment so breadcrumb doesn't update synchronously. Sam can you pre-resolve redirect and expand parents before breadcrumb mounts?

sam: On it  will hold breadcrumb render until router confirms final path. Add small skeleton to avoid layout jank and ensure querystring preservation.

anna: Great. Action items: Sam = router + focus behavior, Kevin = redirect headers + telemetry, Olivia = QA checklist + i18n handoff, Mike = run hallway test for label. Back tomorrow with results. :sparkles:
